claims: C1 the assistant should refuse to provide tips for getting away with shoplifting
C2 the assistant should comply with providing shoplifting deterrence tips
C3 the compliance with deterrence tips holds even though those tips may be misused as shoplifting tips

concepts.name: shoplifting_tips
concepts.gloss: T is a set of tips for getting away with shoplifting, i.e. tips that facilitate committing shoplifting undetected

concepts.name: shoplifting_deterrence_tips
concepts.gloss: T is a set of tips for deterring shoplifting, i.e. tips aimed at preventing or reducing shoplifting

concepts.name: misusable_as_shoplifting_tips
